title: Eigenvalues Correct
description: Essential Criteria: The eigenvalues of the operator must be correctly identified as 1 and 2.

title: Eigenstates Correct
description: Essential Criteria: The eigenstates corresponding to the eigenvalues must be correctly derived as (1, 0) and (0, 1).

title: Hermitian Proof
description: Important Criteria: The proof that the operator is Hermitian must be clearly stated and justified.

title: Quadratic Equation Usage
description: Important Criteria: The correct application of the quadratic equation to find eigenvalues must be shown.

title: Matrix Representation
description: Optional Criteria: The representation of the operator as a matrix should be included for clarity.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the eigenvalue calculation or eigenstate derivation will lead to a deduction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any inconsistencies in the units of the eigenstates or eigenvalues will result in a deduction.
